scope: Universal emulator evidence; CUSA34384 identifies the test only
runtime_result: RADV context loss and Device lost during submit; gameplay not recovered
capture_errors: Scheduled 11s ImageMagick and ffmpeg capture attempts timed out; scheduled 21s ImageMagick could not open display :0. No screenshot-based claim about this run's pixels.

shader_evidence.coverage_limit: These are modules compiled during this run, not every shader in the game. Markers and captured modules do not prove successful GPU memory reads.

actual_module_review.method: Read the uploaded SPIR-V words directly with a local targeted parser; no synthetic replacement shader modules used for this inspection.
actual_module_review.checks: Instruction framing; branch targets and terminators; Phi incoming predecessor labels and value types; function-call argument and return types; load/store pointer types; boolean branch conditions; SSA dominance for an explicit subset of typed operations.
actual_module_review.limits: This is NOT the complete Khronos SPIR-V validator and NOT execution/semantic validation. It does not validate every instruction constraint, resource contents, synchronization, divergence or guest-to-host instruction equivalence. Inspection has not identified a causal shader error.
actual_module_review.spirv_val: Not installed on host or analysis container. Attempts to retrieve a validator into the analysis environment failed; no official-validator PASS is claimed.
actual_module_review.semantic_review: Inspected captured dynamic-load helper bodies and several generated loop bodies against the supplied compiler source. No originating GPU fault or incorrect runtime value established. Do not turn missing residency evidence into a proven cause.

progress_accounting: Capture success and candidate source-level fixes are not gameplay progress. Previously demonstrated gameplay remains the behavioural acceptance baseline. Several prior trials changed code without establishing that it was responsible for the failing workload; that approach has not recovered gameplay.
next_acceptance_gate: Before requesting another crash-prone game trial, tie the proposed correction to an observed failure in the captured workload or to a reproducible discrepancy against the retained working behaviour. Existing unit/model passes alone are insufficient. Do not repeat the unchanged candidate or add unrelated correctness fixes merely because they compile.
privacy: Captured guest shader binaries and generated modules were inspected locally and have not been uploaded to the public repository. This record contains hashes, counts and conclusions only.
